hero.title: Nordic Emergency ApS
hero.tagline: VR-based emergency response and CPR training — clinical precision when it matters.
hero.lead: We build VR platforms that let you train decisions, teamwork and life-saving action again and again — in realistic scenarios, without risk, and without compromising clinical accuracy.

solutions.intro: NordicEmergency develops two VR platforms built around the same core idea: the best decisions in a crisis are the ones you've already practised. Whether it's a full-scale multi-agency emergency exercise or resuscitating an unconscious patient, our platforms give you a safe space to practise, fail and improve — again and again.

items.title: Disaster & Emergency Response Training
items.description: A multi-user VR simulation where fire services, police, authorities and rescue services train together in the same scenario — each from their own perspective. A gamemaster controls the scenario and can change the incident in real time, add complications or escalate the pressure, just like in a real crisis. The goal isn't just individual skill, but the cross-agency coordination and communication that determines whether a response succeeds.
highlights: Multi-user — several participants in the same scenario, at the same time
Gamemaster-controlled: the scenario adapts in real time
Trains coordination across fire services, police, authorities and rescue services
Repeatable training without risk or logistics

items.title: First Aid & CPR Training
items.description: VR training in first aid and CPR, built on recognised clinical guidelines. You practise chest compressions, AED use, and the critical first minutes where confidence and correct technique can make the difference between life and death — in a safe environment where you can repeat the scenario until it becomes second nature.
highlights: Practise chest compressions and AED use
Repeat the scenario until the response becomes automatic
No equipment, no logistics — train whenever it suits you

academy.description: Academy is for those who want to lead the training themselves. We train gamemasters who can run and adapt the multi-user scenarios behind our emergency response platform, and CPR instructors who can facilitate realistic first-aid training for others. You get both the clinical grounding and the instructional skills to make the training credible — whether it takes place at a fire station, a hospital, or a workplace.

labs.description: Labs is our internal R&D environment — where new VR concepts, scenarios and technologies are developed, tested and challenged long before they reach users. We work closely with clinicians, educators and gamemasters to understand how didactic learning principles best translate from a virtual experience into an action you can rely on in reality.

thk.title: CEO, BSc., MBA
thk.bio: Thomas is an electrical engineer and executive with 25 years' experience in leadership roles across tech and industrial companies. He now leads product strategy and technical architecture for VR- and AI-based training platforms for healthcare and welfare education, working closely with universities and hospitals.

rtk.title: Senior Medical Trainer, Paramedic
rtk.bio: Ricki is a development consultant at DAPUC — the Danish Prehospital Education Centre — and a trained paramedic with extensive experience in prehospital education and competence development.

mgs.title: Senior Consultant Physician
mgs.bio: Mads Sommer is a senior consultant physician at Sygehus Sønderjylland, an emergency physician and helicopter doctor who also works on health innovation and virtual reality (VR) for life-saving first aid training.

contact.description: Want to know more about our VR platforms, get certified through Academy, or have an idea you think belongs in Labs? Get in touch — we're happy to answer questions about anything from technology and pricing to implementation at your organisation.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How we handle personal data when you visit nordicemergency.dk.

sections.heading: Data controller
paragraphs: Nordic Emergency ApS (Danish company registration no. 46 72 47 12), Fussingsvej 8, 8700 Horsens, Denmark, is the data controller for the personal data described in this policy.

sections.heading: What information we collect
paragraphs: This website is a static site with no user accounts, login or payment processing. We only collect personal data when you choose to give it to us.

When you fill in the contact form, it opens your own email client with a pre-filled message addressed to us. Your name, email address and message are not sent to a server operated by NordicEmergency — we only receive the information once you press send in your own email client.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: We do not use cookies, and we do not use any third-party analytics or tracking tools.

The website stores two optional preferences in your browser's local storage (localStorage): your chosen language and your chosen light or dark theme. This information never leaves your device and is used only to remember your preferences the next time you visit.

sections.heading: Hosting and third parties
paragraphs: The website is hosted via GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.). As with most websites, the hosting provider typically records standard server log data — such as IP address, browser type and time of visit — for operational and security purposes. We do not have access to these logs and do not process them ourselves.
Some pages link to LinkedIn and Discord. If you follow one of these links, that service's own privacy policy applies to your use of it.

sections.heading: Retention
paragraphs: Since the contact form does not send data to us, we do not retain personal data from your visit to the website. If you email us directly, we keep that correspondence for as long as needed to respond to and follow up on your enquiry.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have a number of rights, which you can exercise at any time by contacting us:
items: The right to access the information we hold about you
The right to have inaccurate information corrected
The right to have your information deleted
The right to object to processing

sections.heading: Complaints
paragraphs: You always have the right to lodge a complaint with the Danish Data Protection Agency, Datatilsynet (datatilsynet.dk), if you are unhappy with how we handle your personal data.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We update this policy whenever our handling of information changes. The latest version is always available on this page, with the update date shown at the top.

By creating an organisation account, or by logging in as a User, you accept these terms on your own behalf and, where applicable, on behalf of the Organisation.

sections.heading: About the portal and the VR app
paragraphs: The portal is an administration and learning platform (LMS) from which the Organisation can create and manage Users, assign access to the associated VR app, and track Users' progress and certificates. The actual training in first aid and emergency response takes place in the VR app, which the User accesses through the licence the Organisation assigns in the portal.

Access to the VR app is provided through a number of user licences (seats) determined by the Organisation's subscription. The Organisation assigns seats to named Users through the portal and may at any time revoke a seat and assign it to a different User. The number of seats assigned at any one time must not exceed the number the Organisation has subscribed for.

Users are responsible for keeping their password and other credentials confidential and must not share them with others. Suspected unauthorised access to an account or the VR app must be reported immediately to the Organisation's administrator or to us.

sections.heading: Subscription and payment
paragraphs: Access to the portal and the VR app requires a valid subscription taken out by the Organisation, including the number of user licences (seats) the Organisation has subscribed for. Pricing, payment terms and the subscription period are set out in the agreement the Organisation has entered into with us. You must not share your account or your user licence with others, attempt to circumvent access controls or security measures, reverse engineer the portal or the VR app, or otherwise use them in a way that is unlawful or harmful to us, other Organisations or their Users.
